Maya (CS): Quick check — Flux beta cohort metrics dropped overnight, active sessions -12% vs yesterday. Notable: increase in 502s on /api/generate. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Marco (CS): Yep saw it at 04:10 UTC. Errors spike in eu-west-1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/flux?view=cohort24h
Priya (CS Ops): Logs show repeated timeout to model-worker-7: 'RPCError: connection reset'. tail: ```2026-03-22T04:12:03Z ERROR model-worker-7 RPCError connection reset by peer```
Ben (Product): Thx. Were any model variants rolled yesterday? do we have rollout ids?
Sam (Solutions): We ran a small canary of quantized-v2 around 01:30 — ~3% traffic in eu-west-1. Might be related.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished — quantized-v2 rolled back to 0% in eu-west-1 at 01:48 UTC after error spike.
Marco (CS): Customer Flux reported slow responses and a couple of failing requests end-to-end. They've paused critical validation tests.
Maya (CS): Action items — 1) Confirm rollback resolved errors across cohort (Priya) 2) Reach out to Flux PM with root cause + ETA (Sam) 3) Collect sample error traces + user impact (Marco). Proposed 15-min async Huddle at 09:15 PT. :calendar:
Priya (CS Ops): Scanning metrics now — errors dropped after rollback, 502s back to baseline in the last 20m. Will attach traces and a short note.
Sam (Solutions): I'll message Flux PM and offer a short postmortem + temporary traffic pin to stable model.
Ben (Product): Also flag Optimize team — quantization config may need stricter regression checks pre-rollout.
Maya (CS): Thanks all. Sam please cc sales if renewal convo might be impacted. I'll open a customer follow-up note. :white_check_mark:
Marco (CS): Collecting top 3 request/response examples for product review. Sample IDs: req_78f3, req_78f4, req_78fa.
Priya (CS Ops): Trace links: https://logs.redwood/trace/78f3 https://logs.redwood/trace/78f4 https://logs.redwood/trace/78fa — attaching short stack snippets in the thread.
Sam (Solutions): Reached out to Flux PM, set 30m sync tomorrow to walk through impact and remediation plan.
Maya (CS): Closing this quickround. If anything spikes again ping #eng-runtime or page oncall. :telephone_receiver:
